anime.description: Generate an anime image with AnimeAPI
anime.usage: Describe the picture in plain words. Example: anime a girl with a red umbrella at a rainy bus stop

messages.no-prompt: Tell me what to draw, for example: anime a girl with a red umbrella
messages.too-long: That prompt is too long. Keep it under 1000 characters.
messages.cooldown: Please wait {0}s before generating another image.
messages.busy-user: Your previous image is still being drawn.
messages.no-key: AnimeAPI is not set up yet. The bot owner needs to add an API key in the plugin settings (get one at https://animeapi.ai/dashboard/api-keys).
messages.invalid-key: The bot's AnimeAPI key was not accepted. The bot owner should check it at https://animeapi.ai/dashboard/api-keys
messages.no-balance: The bot's AnimeAPI balance is empty. The bot owner can add funds at https://animeapi.ai/dashboard/billing
messages.blocked-nsfw: That image was flagged as NSFW and was not sent. Try a different prompt.
messages.busy: AnimeAPI is busy right now. Try again in a few seconds.
messages.bad-model: Unknown model. Use anime, ultra or ultra-max.
messages.bad-orientation: Unknown orientation. Use portrait, square or landscape.
messages.model-locked: Only the default model is enabled on this bot.
